finalReviewRepairs: UInt32 erasure/backfill parameters preserve high site IDs and cannot wrap onto foreign sites.
Heatmap report and cohort timezone validation canonicalizes IANA aliases and rejects fixed offsets unsupported by ClickHouse.
String identity operators use effective visitor identity across devices while preserving shared-device guards.
Cohort calendar validation rejects year zero before Postgres.
limitations: Backgrounds are live sandboxed iframes, not stored historical screenshots; geometry-only rendering remains available.
Historical cohort membership reflects retained analytics and can shrink after expiry or erasure.
Redis and ClickHouse do not form a distributed transaction. Reports deduplicate persisted site/batch/event-index identities before aggregation after ambiguous acknowledgements.
Warm service benchmarks exclude HTTP and response serialization; internal storage-row JSON measurements are not browser wire payload sizes.
Existing empty Stripe-key errors and replay-dashboard HTTP 500 are documented separately; actual recorder/upload/read regression and heatmap cold loads passed.
Prior interrupted attempts, harness corrections and an unattributed frame-gap outlier are retained in individual evidence files.
